title: Trump’s National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross fired amid widespread tech outages
summary: President Donald Trump backed the firing of National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross over cybersecurity credentials, with Kirsten A. Davies stepping in.

title: Trump clears hurdle in $15 billion lawsuit against New York Times
summary: President Donald Trump’s legal team celebrated Thursday after a judge denied The New York Times’ motion to dismiss a $15 billion defamation lawsuit against the paper.

title: Trump scores key win over House progressive accused of assaulting ICE agent
summary: New Jersey Rep. LaMonica McIver says she faces 17 years in prison after the 3rd Circuit refused to reconsider her ICE charges at Delaney Hall.

summary: Senate Democrats and rebel Republicans fail to pass a war powers resolution over Trump's Iran war, as Tim Kaine denies Republican shutdown threats.

title: Wife of American wrongfully detained in China calls for his release after Trump-Xi meeting

summary: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez would not rule out a 2028 White House run, saying her focus is getting results for people after Democrats reclaimed the House majority.

summary: Chinese officials barred Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern from the meeting of President Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin after her earlier question.
